title: story-035 NudgeRatchet faithfulness deviations: decimal-scale mint-debt under-mint + non-monotonic 'ratchet' naming
lawTriggered: Law-1 (security overrides faithful story) + Law-2 (cosmetic naming deviation)
description:
Faithfulness (Law-2) record for two story-035 deviations on NudgeRatchet, cross-referenced from the H/M and QA channels:

1. Decimal-scale under-mint (cross-ref Medium M-03). onDispatch faithfully mirrors the 18-dp USDS sibling's (amount*ratio)/100 formula, but applied to 6-dp USDC vs 18-dp phUSD it under-mints the phUSD mint-debt by ~1e12x (silent no-op). This is a Law-1 'faithful-but-unsafe-story' case: a literal-faithful implementation that does not achieve story-035's intended mint-debt accrual. Because it ALSO has value-tracking impact it carries an H/M label (M-03) with the full report; F-02-035 is its faithfulness cross-ref.

2. Non-monotonic 'ratchet' naming (cross-ref QA Q-06). setRatio freely re-sets the ratio up or down in [0, MAX_RATIO], contradicting the monotonic-up invariant the 'Ratchet' name implies. Cosmetic Law-2 deviation, no asset impact; QA-bundled as Q-06.

Labeled F-02-035 (story-035-scoped) deliberately to avoid colliding with existing ledger L-05's bare F-02 faithfulnessTag.
recommendation: Normalize USDC 6-dp -> phUSD 18-dp (exactly 1e12) in onDispatch (see M-03; the fix is a MANDATORY re-audit item to avoid an over-mint sign flip), and either enforce monotonic-up setRatio or rename/document the component to match its freely-settable ratio (see Q-06).
